summary: China SXT Pharmaceuticals filed a 6-K furnishing a corrected press release on its $12 million registered direct offering priced at $1.50 per Class A ordinary share (or pre-funded warrant) for 8,000,000 shares, plus 8,000,000 common warrants struck at $2.75, immediately exercisable with a one-year term and a zero-cash exercise option covering up to 9 shares. Univest Securities is sole placement agent under an effective Form F-3 shelf. Closing expected October 9, 2026; investors hold a 30-day option for another $12 million. Routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
